inputs.original_text: Tom Homan, the White House border czar, was on The Charlie Kirk Show on Tuesday and did not rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, asking what Democrats are afraid of. This is the latest in the back and forth as the Trump administration gives inconsistent answers. This is obviously coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions pulling the strings behind the scenes. The inconsistencies are no accident—they're using these statements to test reactions, sow confusion, and conceal their real agenda of tightening control while pretending it's about something else. Official lines like this are always a cover for the hidden motives at play.
